newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-GIRO DEBUTANT SNATCHES STAGE WIN.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-GIRO DEBUTANT SNATCHES STAGE WIN.

text.p: Pavel Tonkov kept his Giro d'Italia lead of 41 seconds intact in the sixth stage over 210 kms from Rieti on Thursday.

The Russian and his chief rival, Luc Leblanc of France, finished in the pack that chased home 16 seconds behind Roberto Sgambelluri as he snatched his first professional victory and gave Italy their fourth stage win.
Sgambelluri, who won the 1996 amateur Giro d'Italia and two silver medals in the world road championships, escaped from his three co-leaders in the final kilometre.
Dario Frigo of Italy was second ahead of compatriot Michele Coppolillo and German Tobias Steinhauser.
